description: This file defines the interface class IGstWebAudioPlayerClient, which is used for notification callbacks related to the web audio player's state in the Rialto gstreamer media framework. It includes licensing information, include guards, necessary includes, and a single pure virtual method notifyState.

classes.name: IGstWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for web audio player state notifications within the Rialto gstreamer media framework.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Pure virtual method to notify the client of the current web audio player state.
